title: 3 former Willmar High School athletes appear on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
text:
3 former Willmar High School athletes appear on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
Three former Willmar High School athletes are on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Senior Deshawna Hodges is listed with the North Central (MN) women's soccer program. North Central (MN) is scheduled to host Faith Baptist Bible College on Sept. 1.
The represented sports are women's volleyball, women's soccer and cross country. North Central (MN), Saint Francis (IN), Sioux Falls and Southwest Minnesota State are the college teams listed. The listed teams have 11 scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events appear below.
Former Willmar High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Deshawna Hodges
North Central (MN) women's soccer — UMAC
Schedule: Hosts Faith Baptist Bible College on September 1 in Minneapolis, MN; Visits College of St. Scholastica on September 4 in Duluth, MN
Gretchen Volk
Sioux Falls women's volleyball
Schedule: Hosts Emporia State on September 3 in Sioux Falls, SD; Hosts Black Hills State on September 4 in Sioux Falls, SD; Hosts Washburn on September 4 in Sioux Falls, SD; Hosts Chadron State on September 5 in Sioux Falls, SD
Charlotte Nauman-Marti
Southwest Minnesota State cross country — NSIC
Schedule: Visits Augustana Twilight on September 4 in Sioux Falls, SD
